A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Elastic-Cache work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison across relocations and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original accuracy, throughput, cache-behavior analyses, ablations, and generated examples in its main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds model evaluations, comparator results, robustness tests, and resource measurements.

M1.justification: The core sliding-window, attention-triggered, depth-selective caching procedure remains. Appendix C additionally evaluates procedural variants that monitor multiple most-attended tokens and integrate AdaBlock adaptive window sizing.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP, MathVista, and MathVerse. Dream-7B, alternative decoding schedules, and additional hardware configurations expand model and protocol coverage within these retained tasks.

E2.justification: Beyond v1's quantitative comparisons with uncached/confidence-aware models and Fast-dLLM, v2 adds dKV-Cache, dLLM-Cache, and DeepCache at two intervals in Table 2, uncached LLaDA-V columns in Table 5, and Consistency LLMs in Table 20. Table 16 also evaluates an AdaBlock combination.

E3.justification: New evaluation designs include Dream-v0-Base-7B, controlled fixed-token and confidence-based denoising schedules, peak-memory measurements, one- versus two-GPU execution with batch sizes 4 and 8, and single-token versus parallel multimodal decoding. Existing benchmark metrics, few-shot settings, and main hyperparameter tables remain.

E4.justification: v2 adds joint window/threshold sweeps, top-k tracking ablations, block-caching removal, AdaBlock integration, denoising-schedule robustness, resource/scalability analyses, and cross-benchmark token-stability measurements. Existing ablations and qualitative examples remain; Table 17 largely redisplays the earlier threshold and update-frequency analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added tables continue reporting point estimates.

E6.justification: Original benchmark scores are retained, including v1 Tables 1–2 becoming v2 Tables 1 and 3. Numerous new results appear: Dream-7B GSM8K reaches 75.6% at 169.4 t/s, and the two-GPU experiment reports 225.5 t/s. These are additional experimental results, not established improvements over v1 under matched settings.

T1.justification: Appendix A's assumptions, definitions, Theorems A.8–A.9, and proofs are unchanged; the new main-text theorem passage restates existing mathematics. Appendix C.2 adds limited asymptotic cost analysis comparing O(K²H) cache triggering with O(K²HD) attention and O(KH) cosine checks.

C1.justification: The central contribution remains training-free, architecture-agnostic caching that adaptively selects when and where to refresh while preserving generation quality. The abstract drops the specific 4.8× HumanEval example, whose result remains in Table 1, without redefining the main claims.

C2.justification: New interpretations attribute memory savings to selective updates and MASK caching, recommend token-tracking/window choices, argue against adaptive window sizing, and discuss compatibility with parallel decoding and advantages over consistency-based acceleration. The original discussion of variable query lengths complicating batching is removed.

D1.justification: v2 documents additional comparator intervals, token-tracking settings, computational dimensions, and GPU/batch configurations. However, it removes v1 Appendix C's batch-concatenation explanation and Algorithm 2. The detailed original hyperparameter table and code-release statement remain.

R1.justification: v2 adds the AdaBlock-DLLM reference and discusses its integration, while expanding comparison with already-cited caching and consistency approaches. The main related-work survey and novelty positioning remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: Most original prose and the main section order remain. Changes include shorter preliminary/method explanations, clarified runtime layer-boundary selection, a theorem cross-reference, author-affiliation edits, and replacement of the batching appendix with an eight-subsection experimental appendix.

P2.justification: v2 adds fourteen tables, expands and reformats the multimodal comparison, removes the batch-attention algorithm display, and substantially resizes/reflows material within narrower page margins. The three original figures and qualitative examples are retained rather than replaced with new evidence.

improvement.justification: Additional comparators, Dream-7B evaluation, and targeted component ablations strengthen empirical validation beyond v1. The benefit is limited by removal of batching implementation details and insufficient reconciliation of new comparison settings, including the differing Elastic-Cache results in Tables 2 and 3. The expanded evidence also retains point-estimate-only reporting.
